summary: A row of buttons and controls, like the main navigation bar with back/forward/reload.
description: No dedicated class exists for the generic XUL <toolbar> tag itself; navigator-toolbox.js's event delegation is attached to the outer #navigator-toolbox container (the toolbox), not to any individual <toolbar> (nav-bar, PersonalToolbar, TabsToolbar), so there is no meaningful implementation distinct from 'toolbox' in this file beyond the fact that events bubble up from buttons inside those toolbars to the container's listeners.
